new_concerns_this_audit.title: reset() does NOT cancel in-flight confirmOrderWithAuthRetry — order completes in background after cashier 'cancels'

evidence.details: reset() clears _quoteRefreshTimer (line 585-588) and emits modalHide. But confirmOrderWithAuthRetry uses no AbortController. The posOrder/save action (posOrder.js:save) has its own internal AbortController with 30s timeout for network — but it's bound to network, NOT to the modal lifecycle. If a cashier clicks ✕ at second 5 of a 10s server roundtrip, the modal hides but the Promise resolves, handleOrderSuccess runs, $emit('order:confirmed') fires, defensive modalHide does nothing (already hidden), then showReceiptModalFromDom opens the receipt unexpectedly.

new_concerns_this_audit.exploit_path: 1. Cashier clicks Confirmer → loading=true, POST in flight. 2. Cashier realises wrong order, clicks ✕ → reset() → modal closes, paymentMode='cash', tranches=[]. 3. Server returns 201 → handleOrderSuccess runs → openDrawer fires (CASH order created in DB) → emit order:confirmed → receipt opens. 4. Cashier sees a printed receipt for an order they thought they cancelled. No undo path. NF525 chain advanced.
new_concerns_this_audit.owner_path: FROZEN §7 — bundle into LOCK_PAY_TELEMETRY (or a new LOCK_PAY_RACE_CANCEL). Add AbortController stored on `this._submitAbort`; reset() calls `this._submitAbort?.abort()`. catch path in confirmOrder detects ERR_CANCELED and silently ignores. ~12 LOC.
recommendation_TEXT_ONLY_NO_PATCH: Option A (preferred): Stash AbortController in data(), pass via posOrder/save payload, abort() in reset(). posOrder.js already supports signal — extend save() to honor payload.signal.
Option B: Defer reset() if loading.isActive (refuse to close mid-submit, show alertService.warning). Simpler but UX-hostile — cashier feels modal is frozen.
Option C (V2): Wrap modal close in a 2-step: 'Cancel in-flight payment?' confirm dialog. Heavyweight.

new_concerns_this_audit.title: setInterval(60s) refreshQuote is multi-only — CASH/CARD mode left open >300s expires server-side quote

evidence.lines_verified: 472-480 (mounted setInterval), 474 (if paymentMode !== 'multi' return), 866 (confirmOrder always refreshQuote before save)
evidence.details: The polling early-returns for non-multi modes (line 474). A cashier who opens payment modal in CASH mode, gets distracted (chef rush, phone call), comes back >300s later → quote expired server-side. confirmOrder calls refreshQuote at line 866 which DOES re-fetch — so the cashier WILL get a fresh quote at submit-time. BUT: alignCashReceivedWithQuotedTotal (line 753-783) only handles CASH and only bumps received UP if server total > received. If server total CHANGED in the meantime (price refresh, promo expiry), the cashier sees the auto-bump toast — but in CARD mode there is NO such alignment logic, and the cashier may have visually committed to a wrong total they saw 5 minutes ago.
evidence.ux_friction: PROP-019 verified Echo is N/A but missed this polling asymmetry. The multi-mode polling exists precisely because multi is slower to enter (tranche editing) — but CARD mode (selecting TPE + typing last-4 digits) can also take >300s on a chatty customer.

new_concerns_this_audit.owner_path: FROZEN §7. Two options: (a) Always poll regardless of mode (cheap — drop line 474 early-return). (b) Visible 'quote expires in N seconds' countdown chip on the hero card. (a) is minimum-viable.
recommendation_TEXT_ONLY_NO_PATCH: Bundle into LOCK_PAY_TELEMETRY. Remove the `if (this.paymentMode !== 'multi') return;` guard at line 474. The refresh cost is one POST every 60s (negligible). Keep the existing loading-guard + try/catch so silent fail.
Optional UX upgrade: add a v-if='quoteAge > 240' chip 'Quote expire bientôt — rafraîchir maintenant' near the hero amount. Visual telemetry.

new_concerns_this_audit.title: posOrder/save reject handler ONLY catches 409 with idempotency-key-conflict header — typed PaymentAlreadyCollectedException 409 would fall through to generic handlePaymentError

evidence.details: Reject branch: `else if (err?.response?.status === 409 && err?.response?.headers?.['idempotency-key-conflict'])`. PaymentAlreadyCollectedException (Handler.php:80-92) ships 409 with `error_code: payment_already_collected` in BODY, no special header. If admin/pos ever throws this exception (today it does NOT — confirmCounterPayment is the only thrower), the reject would fall through to `reject(err)` and handlePaymentError shows the generic error message. new_concerns_this_audit.title: Mode-switch wipes input without preserving cashier intent — typed value lost cross-mode

evidence.details: Cashier types 50.00 in cash mode, realises they should encaisser by card → taps CARD tab → setPaymentMode('card') → paymentMethod(CARD, 'cardInput') → resetPaymentInputs wipes BOTH cashInput AND cardInput. The 50.00 is lost. This is the J-STEP-POS P7-FRICTION-2 finding. The fix is to preserve the typed value cross-mode if the new mode's input is empty.

new_concerns_this_audit.owner_path: FROZEN §7 — LOCK_PAY_INPUTS bundle. ~10 LOC patch in setPaymentMode: read current input value, set destination input value after mode flip if destination is empty.

Watch out: paymentMethod() emits payment-form:patch which resets pos_received_amount=null — that's the source of truth for the cash backend. Need careful re-emit if amount preserved.
